result.rationale: Quinbrook identifies GlidePath as the manager-level portfolio company and Prospect Storage as an operating project beneath it. Company, court, Texas, and ERCOT evidence ties West Columbia Storage LLC to GlidePath. The standalone project record is consolidated into GlidePath while preserving its greenfield-development and December 12, 2019 operating history.

evidence.purpose: Official evidence that GlidePath is the portfolio company and Prospect is its project
Official Prospect project profile, capacity, and operating status
Official ERCOT operating-resource and December 12, 2019 in-service evidence
Court evidence that West Columbia Storage LLC is a wholly owned GlidePath subsidiary
